QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` builds with Clang MemorySanitizer... `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` runs `make memcheck`... The tests are the only way the claim is verified
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: It says MSan/Valgrind verify the property, but it never says the facility is off-by-default or that it is explicitly not part of the library API.
